entries: While wearing this armor, you gain a +2 bonus to AC.

Once you wear this armor, and are attuned to it, you can't remove it. Only the {@spell Remove Curse} spell allows you to end the attunement and finally doff it. While wearing the armor, you're vulnerable to the following damage types: force, lightning, psychic, radiant, and thunder.
entries.name: Curse

entries: This item corrupts. See the "{@adventure Infernal Item Corruption|CoA|16|Infernal Item Corruption}" section.
entries.name: Corrupting
